BiblicalUsage: Baza means to cleave, to cut off, and Isaiah uses it for the land beyond the rivers of Ethiopia whose ambassadors go by the sea in vessels of bulrushes, a nation scattered and peeled.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the scattered nation is still known to God, and Isaiah says a present will yet be brought to the Lord from that far land.
